name: Spider
blurb: Spider is a program designed to make installing and using web apps simple and powerful while integrating with the GNOME desktop.
description:
Spider is a program designed to make installing and using web apps simple
and powerful
while integrating with the GNOME desktop.

• Sandboxed: Each web app is completely isolated

• Adaptive Window Styling: Each app's titlebar adapts to it's
theme color

• High quality icons: Scrapes websites for a high quality icons
to use

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.

install.label: F-Droid
install.note: Adds F-Droid as an update source, so you keep getting updates.
